title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache parallelism
author: Liam Chen
description:
Motivation: our monolithic CI workflow has accumulated years of ad-hoc steps, long matrix runs, and cache contention which slow down feedback and make release automation brittle. This PR splits lint/test/release flows, consolidates shared steps into a reusable workflow, and improves cache key hygiene and parallelism to reduce CI latency and cache misses.

Scope: 1) Add separate workflows for lint, unit/integration tests, and release automation; 2) Extract common setup and cache restore/save into .github/workflows/actions/common-ci.yml (reusable workflow); 3) Reduce build/test matrix dimensions where safe (node versions trimmed to supported LTSs, GPU/CPU split for perf tests); 4) Improve cache keys to include OS+node+lockfile-hash and pin actions versions for reproducibility; 5) Add cache warming job for release workflow to avoid cold-cache publish latency; 6) Add flaky-test detection wrapper and retry-on-failure for known intermittent tests.

Checklist: - [x] Split workflows: ci-lint.yml, ci-test.yml, release.yml - [x] Extracted reusable workflow for common steps - [x] Reduced matrix size and pinned critical actions - [x] Improved cache keys and added cache-warming step for release - [x] Added test retry wrapper for flaky suites - [x] Updated CI docs in tools/ci/README.md

Testing and rollout: changes validated by running full pipeline on fork and then in main with staged merges. We ran 3 consecutive CI runs after fixes for a flaky integration test (tests/auth/refresh_token.test.ts) and verified retries reduced flakes. Measured median CI time for unit+lint dropped from ~22m to ~13m (with cache hits) and release job warmup time reduced ~45s on average.

Follow-ups: a) Further split the monorepo release steps once release notes automation (ENG-1589) lands, b) add optional matrix expansion for experimental branches, c) monitor build cache hit rate in Redwood Console and iterate on cache key strategy.

release_notes:
- CI: split workflows (lint/test/release) to improve feedback loop and reduce job contention.
- CI: improved cache key hygiene and added cache-warm step for release jobs.
- CI: reduced test matrix to supported Node LTS versions (18,20).
- Tests: added retry wrapper for known flaky integration tests.
- Docs: updated tools/ci/README.md with new workflow usage and cache key guidance.
notes_for_qa: Run full ci-test workflow locally using scripts/ci/run-local.sh and verify cache restore/save behavior with CACHE_KEY env set. Verify flaky test retry reduces flakes from CI runs in staging.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-1660: migrate flaky-test harness to test-runner v2; ENG-1589: integrate release-notes automation with split release workflow; Monitor CI metrics for 2 weeks and iterate on cache keys.
notes: This PR intentionally avoids changing runtime code; changes are CI-only and doc updates. We validated by running three successive full CI runs post-merge to ensure no regressions in release automation.
